description: This PHP source file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class EmpEmergencyContactSearchFilterParams used for filtering emergency contact search results within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for employee emergency contacts. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties such as employee number and contact name, along with corresponding getter and setter methods. The class also defines allowed sorting fields and initializes default sort behavior.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering employee emergency contact search queries, including sorting and filtering parameters such as employee number and contact name.
